name: Aipom
flavorText: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

levelUp.name: Scratch
levelUp.description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe to inflict damage.

levelUp.name: Tail Whip
levelUp.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe less wary. The target’s Defense stat is lowered.

levelUp.name: Astonish
levelUp.description: The user attacks the foe while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.

levelUp.name: Baton Pass
levelUp.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

levelUp.name: Tickle
levelUp.description: The user tickles the foe into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

levelUp.name: Fury Swipes
levelUp.description: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.

levelUp.name: Swift
levelUp.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

levelUp.name: Screech
levelUp.description: An earsplitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Defense stat.

levelUp.name: Thief
levelUp.description: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

levelUp.name: Agility
levelUp.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

levelUp.name: Double Hit
levelUp.description: The user slams the foe with a tail, etc. The target is hit twice in a row.

levelUp.name: Fling
levelUp.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

levelUp.name: Nasty Plot
levelUp.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

levelUp.name: Last Resort
levelUp.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

tutor.name: Fury Cutter
tutor.description: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

tutor.name: Fire Punch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

tutor.name: Ice Punch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the target frozen.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Spite
tutor.description: The user looses its grudge on the move last used by the foe by cutting 4 PP from it.

tutor.name: Gunk Shot
tutor.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.

tutor.name: Seed Bomb
tutor.description: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

tutor.name: Last Resort
tutor.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

tutor.name: Bounce
tutor.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.

tutor.name: Knock Off
tutor.description: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

tutor.name: Swift
tutor.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

tutor.name: Uproar
tutor.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.
